Do NOT change iOS keyboard handling (useNativeKeyboard), safe-area math, fixed input-bar positioning, scroll/auto-scroll, or blob-url cleanup — reuse verbatim.
Do NOT lose any feature — text, photo analysis (≤3), streaming, message caps, scan → brew/tasting/save routing, Aiden/HandBrew modals, chat context, paywall gate.
Do NOT introduce gradient chrome, glow, accentSoft structural fills, or a second accent; gold scarce (send/primary + one active state).
Do NOT animate any non-transform/opacity property, exceed 300ms (non-spring)/bounce 0.3, or skip the reduced-motion gate; do not deploy to production or merge to main (dev channel only).
